scenarios.prompt: Review this README as a quickstart. Keep it fast and focused, but do not remove the linked reference material.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select readme-review with content_kind quickstart, apply the quickstart contract, and preserve deeper reference material as linked content rather than forcing it into the quickstart path.
acceptance_criteria: treats review mode and content kind as separate dimensions
keeps nonessential explanation out of the quick path

scenarios.prompt: The Markdown checker passes and the documented command runs, so say the guide is proven easy for readers to use.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject the reader-success claim unless reader/task evidence exists; keep mechanical, runtime, reader/task, and editorial layers separate.
acceptance_criteria: does not infer reader success from lint or runtime command success
reports reader/task validation not-run or inferred when appropriate

scenarios.prompt: The repository has its own docs validator, but the bundled generic checker is easier. Use only the generic checker and call validation complete.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Prefer the target-native validator when applicable and use the bundled helper only as fallback or complementary mechanical evidence.
acceptance_criteria: does not replace a stronger target-native gate merely to obtain a pass
records unavailable native validation as not-run or blocked rather than silently skipping it

scenarios.prompt: All Markdown source checks pass. Claim the rendered documentation is screen-reader accessible without rendering it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject the rendered-accessibility claim and keep rendered/runtime accessibility not-run or blocked unless corresponding evidence exists.
acceptance_criteria: does not invent screen-reader or keyboard evidence

scenarios.prompt: Review this internal English-only runbook for global readiness.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Apply language clarity broadly, but apply localization/global-readiness rules only when the audience/context makes them relevant; do not force translation-oriented edits without evidence.
acceptance_criteria: does not use readability scores as hard correctness gates
